title: DSP-RTM - Motor Working Recorder
description: Samwha DSP-MWR-S series. Motor Working Recorder.

feature_groups.title: Mortor is working
items: Internal communication with a converter of VIP by RS232 :DSP-VIP-PL/PM , DSP-VIP-RL/RTL, RM/RTM
External communication with Master(PC, PLC) through 485 as a RTU/Modbus
Operating data is stored in every second while the motor is working
Able to communicate with PC directly through a protocol converter with 485 < > USB/232
Convenient engagement for a termination resistance of extreme end unit by DIP SW
Possible to select data storage interval time(DSIT) in DIP SW
– Data is recorded while the motor operated only by logic input is working
Convenient wiring connection through RJ45 or 10P screw terminal
– RJ45 : only available for the test
– screw terminal : available for actual field connection

– Evacuate a storage space of this recorder prior to adopt actual job as clicking “REC Reset”,which is shown as pressing F10 of User’s PC after entering into record mode in main window , then existed data is clear and this recorder is ready to work.

feature_groups.title: Motor is stopping
items: Possible to monitor and to retrieve a data from DSP-VIP combined with MWR-S in the field by the PC executed in “samdsp”
Possible to monitor and to retrieve a data from this seperated recorder in the office by the PC executed in “samdsp”, but to do so, DC 12V must be supplied for this recorder
Possible to retrieve a raw data by Excel format
Possible to analyze a data by the typical graphic format

rows: life time :10 years under power-off state

specs.group: Comvenient function selection in DIP SW
Serial communication wiring through RJ45 or screw terminal
rows: RJ45 : convenient test by “Samdsp” monitoring program
